text:
SMDC did an excelent job on my dental needs. I had a bad accident last year and broke my fixed-brige set. I went to their clinic for filling, Dr. Sarah was prompt and saved my tooth. Although, it was just temporary filling it worked fine for me as i wait for the replacement of my fixed-bridge Dr. Nut worked on the other teeth that needed treatment.  I finally got my denture last week which fits perfectly and looks natural teeth. The process Dr. Nut did worked perfectly with my work schedule. I did not miss a day at work even after teeth extraction.  He is highly professional and emphatic to patients' need. They are puntual and never late for appointments.
SMDC staff are also great with  appointment schedule and reminders.  They are all friendly. The cost of their service is very affordable as well. Dr. Nut offers options for patients budget.
I highly recommend SMDC to everyone looking for dental service.
As for me, SMDC is the best dental clinic that has the best team of dentists in Bangkok.
I wish you guys the best!
